info.title: Studio TV Product Execution Extension
info.description: Durable product tasks and private history, with opt-in server writeback for one basic canvas NODE. Model execution requires an explicitly enabled configured capability; TEST MODE remains explicit. Media jobs and actual Studio rendering use media-extension. Credentials/native Router IDs and private node guards are not public. Task receipts survive restarts; owner derives from IPAC login + tv.access. Full Agent tool execution remains unavailable.

expectedRevision.description: Optional opt-in to server writeback. Must equal the owner-scoped persisted project revision whose target/input closure matches this frozen graph. Valid only for targetType NODE with one selected rh-text/rh-image/rh-video/rh-audio plan; upstream nodes may still be present. Missing, changed or recreated inputs are rejected. Omit for existing group/canvas/script/storyboard/APP execution paths.

post.description: expectedRevision opts one basic NODE run into an atomic server-owned binding, task state and result-writeback decision. The project revision and event cursor advance in the same transaction, so execution survives page closure; a changed, deleted, recreated or superseded node cannot be overwritten by an old result. Successful task completion and result application are distinct: inspect canvasBinding.applicationState, then refresh the consistent live-snapshot. Existing requests without expectedRevision retain their established execution path. This does not enable an Agent tool loop or arbitrary group/APP/script/storyboard result mutation.

CanvasBinding.description: Server-owned application receipt. PENDING awaits application, APPLIED includes terminal failure/cancellation state application, and DETACHED preserves execution history without overwriting current canvas content. No input guard, node version, owner or provider evidence is public.

errorMessage.description: Optional server-authored media specification error with actual limits and recovery guidance. Never contains a prompt, signed URL, credential or raw provider response.

canvasManaged.description: True only for server-accepted opt-in single basic-node canvas writeback. Absent or false identifies the existing execution path; graph display fields do not supply this authority.
